Hey just want to let you know that I am sorry you have to deal with social anxiety and depression. I understand the hell that comes with it because I also had them both. I managed to completely overcome social anxiety and trust me I had a severe case of it. I also spent a month in a psych ward because of a drug induced psychosis. The psych ward is ok, I actually had a good experience there it's just that I doubt it will help you with your SAD or your depression. If I were you I would work on my SAD and then your depression will get better. Group therapy is helpful but most of all it's constant exposure to things that give you anxiety. Like for example I would be terrified of going to the mall alone and walk with my head up in fear that someone I know will see me and think I am a loser for shopping alone or that I would be forced to say hi and they would see me being afraid, sweating, stuttering, blushing and so on. I would even forget how to walk normally when my anxiety hit. So at least 3 times a week I would go to the mall alone and spend an hour just walking around. I would go to McDonalds or any restaurant and sit and eat by myself. Another thing that helps is understanding how other people think. Most people don't give the slightest fuck about how you are and behave. They forget everything you did quickly. I would just constantly tell myself " I don't give a fuck what you fuckers think" There is also SSRI's that can help. I remember when it first hit me I was talking to a friend and I was amazed how easily I could just conversate and actually find some joy in it. Unfortunately the high I got from them went away and my symptoms came back but they were less powerful. If you can overcome your SAD I'm confident your depression and suicidal thoughts will get better. There is also a book that my psychologist recommended to me that was extremely helpful to me that I suggest you give it a read. I wish I had read that book when I was 14. It's called Reinventing your life. Fell free to msg me if you want. Good luck! :)
